name: Dependency Updates Check
description: Check for dependency updates and security vulnerabilities
instructions:
Check all project dependencies:
1. Identify outdated dependencies
2. Check for security vulnerabilities
3. Categorize updates (major, minor, patch)
4. Check breaking changes in major updates
5. Verify compatibility
6. Suggest update strategy
7. Create update PRs for safe updates

Provide a report with:
- Total dependencies
- Outdated dependencies
- Security vulnerabilities
- Recommended updates
- Breaking changes to watch
- Auto-update candidates (patch versions)
